$schema: Tool configuration for Bitbucket MCP Server
description: Enable or disable MCP tools by setting 'enabled' to true or false

get_pull_requests.description: List pull requests for a repository

get_pull_request.description: Get details for a specific pull request

unapprove_pull_request.description: Remove approval from a pull request

get_pull_request_comments.description: List comments on a pull request

add_pull_request_comment.description: Add a comment to a pull request

get_pull_request_diff.description: Get diff for a pull request

get_pull_request_activity.description: Get activity log for a pull request

get_pull_request_commits.description: Get commits on a pull request

get_pull_request_statuses.description: Get build/CI statuses for a pull request

get_pull_request_diffstat.description: Get file modification statistics for a pull request

list_pipeline_runs.description: List pipeline runs for a repository

get_pipeline_run.description: Get details for a specific pipeline run

get_pipeline_steps.description: List steps for a pipeline run

get_pipeline_step_logs.description: Get logs for a specific pipeline step
